About

A designer who likes
the details as much
as the big idea.

Brand Identity Marketing & Campaign Design Poster & Ad Design Typography Illustration Digital Painting

I'm a passionate and versatile graphic designer with a background in design, typography and illustration. I specialize in creating visually stunning brand identities, marketing materials and digital illustrations that balance aesthetics with functionality.

Every project starts with the same question: what does this actually need to do? From there I move between disciplines — brand marks, marketing posters and ad creative, social and campaign graphics, or hand-drawn illustration — whatever the idea calls for. I'm comfortable working independently against deadlines and collaborating closely with marketing and product teams to keep every touchpoint on-brand.

How I work
01

Understand the brief, the audience and what "success" looks like before opening a design file.

02

Explore concepts in sketch and low-fidelity form — illustration, layout, typography — before committing.

03

Refine with an eye for detail: line weight, color balance, hierarchy, and how it holds up at any size.

04

Deliver assets that are ready for print, screen, or wherever the brand needs to show up.
